gaps.sentence: The two sides failed to reach an ___ (AGREE).
The committee's ___ (DECIDE) was announced this morning.
There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.
'Her persistence' — the quality noun from persistent.

gaps.sentence: This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).

gaps.sentence: His sudden ___ (RESIGN) surprised everyone in the department.
gaps.hint: noun: act of leaving a job

gaps.sentence: He suffers from ___ (SLEEP) since the accident.
